items.title: Amazon Joins Goldman Sachs’ Conviction List Alongside 4 Other Stock Picks
items.summary: Goldman Sachs just overhauled its Conviction List with five new additions, and the upside targets on some of these picks will raise eyebrows. One hyperscaler alone carries a 51% potential gain, but it is far from the biggest number on the list.

items.title: JPMorgan grows wary on AI-exposed industrials, lowers price targets
items.summary: Investing.com -- JPMorgan said it has become far more cautious on industrial stocks tied to AI data center spending, with the bank starting Eaton (NYSE:ETN), Johnson Controls (NYSE:JCI) and Vertiv (NYSE:VRT) at Neutral and lowering the price targets on most of its other AI-linked names.

items.title: 3 U.S. Value Stocks Outside AI for Investors Seeking Steadier Returns
items.summary: AI giants are suddenly on sale, data center plans face fresh roadblocks, and almost $2.9b in S&P 500 market value has evaporated from AI heavyweights. When a crowded story like artificial intelligence stumbles, money often goes hunting for quieter, cash generative businesses that have been ignored. This article walks through three high quality value stocks affected by this shift in sentiment, outlining where some investors see potential shelter and where caution still makes sense. The three...

items.title: Industrial Stocks Drop Amid Fears of AI Data Center Slowdown
items.summary: Shares of industrial companies behind artificial-intelligence data center construction declined broadly on Thursday as investors signaled anxiety that the building boom will be curtailed.
